pylance_pid_30709_mapping: verified: language server startup lines 3 and 4 identify PID 30709
conclusion: Confirmed: the kernel OOM killer terminated Pylance language-server PID 30709 at 17:33:46; Pylance client logged EPIPE at 17:33:52.933. The kernel then terminated VS Code extension-host PID 29523 at 17:34:31, and the remote agent logged the same PID exiting with SIGKILL at 17:34:33.162. Pylance failure and editor extension-host restart were consequences of system memory exhaustion.
actions: read-only diagnosis, no process restart or kill

workspace_mitigation.change: Exclude generated experiment results, builds and backups from Python static analysis; no editor reload or process kill
workspace_mitigation.scope: Reduced analysis load confirmed; does not establish that Pylance alone caused global memory exhaustion or guarantee all interruptions resolved
